core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Safia corresponds to the Arabic form صَفِيَّة (Arabic root ص ف و (ṣ-f-w); صَفِيَّة (Ṣafiyya)). Its core sense is safia; pure, clear (feminine). Safia is Arabic صَفِيَّة (Ṣafiyya) 'pure, clear' (feminine), from the root ص ف و (ṣ-f-w). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave سفيهة (a different form).
